title: 第2111章 十四剑境强者左无剑万妖城木鼎现世第2110章 化身古神猿剑荡万妖
content_zh:
突然爆发出的剑气，震荡九霄，向苍穹深处延伸，宛若无数碎散的流星，惊得数船万余强者心悸，皆下意识地看向天空，生怕那一束束剑光重新坠落下来，直到此时，他们才猛然意识到，世间十四境剑道的强者，究竟有多恐怖！
所谓大乘，所谓真仙，这些千万人无法跨越的境界，无数天才苦修之辈穷尽一生才能抵达的境界，在十四境剑修面前，什么都不是。
白玉京屹立万载，从来依靠的不是名声，而是在岁月里不断洗炼打磨，终磨砺出最锋利的剑。
“了不起的年轻人。”
大剑仙开口的第一句，竟然是在举手投足间抹灭了少年的剑气，破除了法相后不吝称赞顾余生。
“左无剑，是我的名字。”大剑仙在世人面前，郑重地向顾余生说出早已被世人遗忘的名字，“背剑人，你现在可以离开了，这座城会有新的秩序重铸。”
十四境剑修的话不是商量，而是一道命令。
漫天碎落的雪花落在少年身旁，一点点凝成古朴之剑，他紧紧握在手上，雪花渗透的鲜血，沿着剑槽向地面沁落，额头沁出的汗珠被冷风冻结在发梢，他并没有抬头看向天空的众强者，只是缓缓转动眸光，看向万妖城内城外的凡人，抬起头，声音嘶哑：“我可以走，他们呢？”
“你以为自己是谁？救世主吗！”
天道盟副盟主沈焘突兀地出现在顾余生前面，用极为傲慢的目光打量眼前少年，他一个人独行大荒，几乎打乱了天道盟所有的谋划和布局。
顾余生以手指擦拭着剑槽里的鲜血，将剑一点点提起来横在胸前：“当然不是。”
“既然不是，还不快走？小玄界什么时候轮到你来拯救了？你只不过是给这世界带来灾祸的神弃之子罢了。”沈焘双手抱怀，“镜域，时沙，你走过的地方，并没有迎来光明，只有无尽的黑暗，呵，背剑人……连人皇都成传说了，也就秦酒那固执的家伙当回事，你也当真了，哈哈哈……嗝……！”
一阵冷风吹来，沈焘笑容一僵，忽然伸手扼住脖子，鲜血从他指缝里飙射到两边，嘴里喷出一口鲜血，待他忽然意识到什么时，却见少年的剑已再一次刺穿他的心口，却偏偏避开了他要害位置，一个血洞前后穿身。
“你又是什么东西？”顾余生冷笑一声，缓缓地抽出带血的剑，在他耳畔低语，“知道我为什么没取你性命吗？因为死太便宜你了，以后我见你一次，就这样捅你一剑，好好养伤，下一次见面，还这样捅你。”
唰唰唰。
天道盟数十名强者凌空而来，却被顾余生抬起手中剑，轻轻一斩，数十名强者瞬间化作一团血雾炸裂开来。
“收点利息。”
顾余生手腕旋转，带血的剑在掌心旋出美丽的剑花归匣，他纵身一跃，出现在万妖城天柱峰上，回头看向天空威风凛凛的数十艘战船，看向那位天擎般的人间十四境剑修：“我若归来，他们没能活下去，我会向你讨债。”
呼。
一阵清风过，少年踏雪山中，在无数妖修和人族强者的瞩目下，向大荒西面遁行。

“狂妄大胆的家伙！”雁九翎神色愤然，“剑尊，我这就派人……”
“省省吧，多留一些活人好收拾你们摆下的烂摊子。”左无剑说话间，身影已出现在万妖城头，他衣衫袖袍轻轻鼓荡，所有侥幸活下来的妖修皆瑟瑟发抖，竟都不由自主地跪下来，“红妖在何处？”
十三境修为的大妖修们抬起头，神色茫然。
“赐予你们力量的妖祖，她在哪里？”
“我……我等不知，我们是受了苍狐大人的指令，抢夺万妖城。”
“那你们没用了。”
左无剑轻飘飘丢下一句话，一步前移，已在万妖城西边的城墙上，身后，一团巨大的血雾爆裂开来，所有突破至十三境的大妖和妖修，全部陨落，他们抵不过十四境剑修的一念之剑。
同一时间，数十里外的少年，身影微微一顿，瞳孔剧震，他没有回头看，装作无事发生，可背后的剑匣里，两把剑哀哀颤鸣。
天上数十艘战船上，神庭的使者，各大远古世家的强者们，皆无一人敢动，默默地注视着这一切。
人间伊始，剑道十四境，足够震慑太乙。
万妖城外城内的血雾被强大的意志汇聚，最终在万妖城最高的山峰上形成一滴鲜血。
整个世界变成一片血海。
就连数十里外的顾余生，都无法再往任何方向前进，意志坚定的他，亦感觉到整个世界皆是太虚幻境，无数血淋淋的敌人从血雾里爬出来，源源不断地滋生出心魔。
冷汗从顾余生的额头滴落，他畏惧的，并不是周围的尸山血海，而是他生平第一次真正见证了十四境剑道强者的恐怖实力，对方的存在，颠覆了他对剑道所有的认知，过去的剑意，剑势，剑心，剑域，仿佛通通都是虚无。
那一滴汇聚了人族，妖族的鲜血，正将整个世界染红。
就当所有人都不知道这位十四境剑修要做什么时，那一滴巨大的鲜血忽然发出上万根束状纤细的血剑丝，血剑丝在万妖城上方编织成一个血网，向城内缓缓盖罩下来。
嗡！
突然间，寂静的万妖城内，一道苍翠的华光猝然明亮，浓郁的木灵之气将血网冲开一个巨口，在血暗的天空凝行成一方八角木鼎！
木鼎轻轻旋转，从八个角方向激荡出神圣古老的符文，霎时间形成一个木灵伞状，宛若一棵巨树华冠，大地的血雾迅速消退。
神圣的气息驱逐所有人的心魔，接连下了数个月大雪的天空，被木鼎绽放的复苏气息逼退，向着小玄界，向着虚空延伸向太乙。

嗡嗡嗡！
顾余生的体内，那一方古鼎也随之震动共鸣，与之呼应，好在这时所有人的注意力，都被天空的那一尊木鼎吸引，他不由地想起石洞山内范阳老人说过的话，不由地暗自震惊，万妖城内人族的遗宝，竟然是这一方木鼎，虽然木鼎的属性与他拥有的古鼎截然不同，但直觉告诉他，天空的木鼎，绝对是人皇时代遗失的九鼎之一。
content_en:
The sudden burst of sword energy shook the sky and extended deep into the sky, like countless scattered meteors. It shocked the hearts of tens of thousands of strong men on the ship, and they all looked to the sky subconsciously, for fear that the beams of sword light would fall again. Only then did they suddenly realize how terrifying the strong men of the Fourteenth Level of Swordsmanship were in the world!
The so-called Mahayana, the so-called True Immortal, these are realms that millions of people cannot cross, realms that countless geniuses and ascetic cultivators have spent their entire lives to reach. They are nothing in front of the Fourteenth Level Sword Cultivator.
Bai Yujing has stood erect for thousands of years. It has never relied on reputation, but on continuous refinement and polishing over the years, and finally sharpened the sharpest sword.
"Amazing young man."
The first sentence the Great Sword Immortal spoke was to wipe out the young man's sword energy with a single gesture, and he did not hesitate to praise Gu Yusheng after breaking the law.
"Zuo Wujian is my name." The Great Sword Immortal solemnly told Gu Yusheng his name that had long been forgotten by the world in front of the world. "Sword Bearer, you can leave now. This city will be recast with a new order."
The words of the Fourteenth Realm Sword Cultivator were not a discussion, but an order.
The snowflakes falling all over the sky fell next to the young man, and condensed into a simple sword bit by bit. He held it tightly in his hand, and the blood soaked in the snowflakes fell to the ground along the groove of the sword. The sweat beads on his forehead were frozen in the tips of his hair by the cold wind. He did not raise his head to look at the powerful men in the sky, but slowly turned his eyes to look at the mortals inside and outside the City of Ten Thousand Demons. He raised his head and said in a hoarse voice: "I can go, where are they?"
"Who do you think you are? A savior!"
The deputy leader of the Tiandao Alliance, Shen Tao, suddenly appeared in front of Gu Yusheng and looked at the young man in front of him with extremely arrogant eyes. He was walking alone in the wilderness, which almost disrupted all the plans and layouts of the Tiandao Alliance.
Gu Yusheng wiped the blood from the sword slot with his fingers, then lifted the sword little by little and laid it across his chest: "Of course not."
"Since it's not the case, why don't you leave quickly? When will it be your turn to save Xiaoxuan Realm? You are just the abandoned son of the gods who brought disaster to this world." Shen Tao crossed his arms, "Mirror Realm, Shi Sha, where you walked, there was no light, only endless darkness. Ha, the sword-carrying man... Even the Human Emperor has become a legend, and Qin Jiu, that stubborn guy, you also take it seriously, hahaha... burp...!"
A gust of cold wind blew, and Shen Tao's smile froze, and he suddenly stretched out his hands to strangle his neck. Blood spurted from his fingers to both sides, and a mouthful of blood spurted out from his mouth. When he suddenly realized something, he saw that the young man's sword had pierced his heart again, but it avoided his vital position, and a blood hole penetrated his body front and back.
"Who are you?" Gu Yusheng sneered, slowly pulled out the bloody sword, and whispered in his ear, "Do you know why I didn't take your life? Because death is too cheap for you. When I see you once in the future, I will stab you like this and recover well. The next time we meet, I will stab you like this again."
Swish, swish, swish.
Dozens of strong men from the Tiandao Alliance came from the sky, but Gu Yusheng raised his sword and slashed lightly. The dozens of strong men instantly turned into a ball of blood mist and exploded.
"Charge some interest."
Gu Yusheng rotated his wrist, and the bloody sword spun out into a beautiful sword flower in the palm of his hand and returned to the box. He jumped up and appeared on the Tianzhu Peak of Ten Thousand Demons City. He looked back at the majestic dozens of warships in the sky and at the heaven-like sword cultivator of the Fourteenth Realm of the World: "If I come back and they fail to survive, I will collect debts from you."
Phew.
A gust of breeze passed by, and the young man stepped on the snowy mountain. Under the gaze of countless demon cultivators and strong human beings, he fled to the west of the wilderness.
"Arrogant and bold guy!" Yan Jiuling looked angry, "Sword Master, I will send someone right now..."
"Save it, leave more people alive to clean up the mess you have made." As Zuo Wujian spoke, his figure appeared at the top of Ten Thousand Monsters City. His clothes and sleeves fluttered slightly, and all the demon cultivators who were lucky enough to survive were trembling., unexpectedly knelt down involuntarily, "Where is the red demon?"
The great demon cultivators who had reached the thirteenth realm raised their heads with blank expressions.
"The Demon Ancestor who gave you strength, where is she?"
"I...I don't know, but we were ordered by Master Canghu to rob the City of Ten Thousand Demons."
"Then you are useless."
Zuo Wujian lightly said a word and moved forward. He was already on the west wall of Ten Thousand Demons City. Behind him, a huge cloud of blood mist exploded. All the great demons and demon cultivators who had broken through to the Thirteenth Realm fell. They could not withstand the sword of a single thought of the Fourteenth Realm Sword Cultivator.
At the same time, the young man dozens of miles away paused slightly, his pupils trembling sharply. He did not look back, pretending that nothing happened, but in the sword box behind him, two swords trembled sadly.
On dozens of warships in the sky, none of the messengers from the Divine Court and the powerful men from the major ancient families dared to move, watching all this silently.
At the beginning of the human world, the fourteenth realm of swordsmanship was enough to frighten Taiyi.
The blood mist in the outer city of Ten Thousand Demons City was gathered by powerful will, and finally formed a drop of blood on the highest peak of Ten Thousand Demons City.
The whole world turned into a sea of ​​blood.
Even Gu Yusheng, who was dozens of miles away, could not move forward in any direction. He was determined and felt that the whole world was an illusion. Countless bloody enemies crawled out of the blood mist, constantly breeding inner demons.
Cold sweat dripped from Gu Yusheng's forehead. What he was afraid of was not the mountains of corpses and seas of blood around him, but the fact that for the first time in his life, he had truly witnessed the terrifying strength of a master of swordsmanship in the Fourteenth Level. The existence of the other party subverted all his knowledge of swordsmanship. The past sword intention, sword power, sword heart, and sword domain seemed to be nothing.
That drop gathered the blood of the human race and the demon race, dyeing the whole world red.
Just when no one knew what this Fourteenth Level Sword Cultivator was going to do, that huge drop of blood suddenly sent out tens of thousands of slender blood sword threads. The blood sword threads weaved into a blood net above the Ten Thousand Monsters City, slowly covering the city.
Buzz!
Suddenly, in the silent City of Ten Thousand Demons, a green light suddenly brightened, and the rich wood spirit energy opened a huge mouth of the blood net, and formed an octagonal wooden tripod in the blood-dark sky!
The wooden tripod rotated gently, stirring up sacred ancient runes from eight corners. In an instant, it formed a wooden spirit umbrella shape, like a giant tree crown, and the blood mist on the earth quickly subsided.
The sacred aura drove away everyone's inner demons, and the sky, which had been snowing heavily for several months, was forced back by the revitalizing aura blooming from the wooden tripod, extending towards the Mysterious Small World, towards the void, and towards Taiyi.
Buzz!
In Gu Yusheng's body, the ancient tripod also vibrated and resonated, echoing with it. Fortunately, everyone's attention was attracted by the wooden tripod in the sky. He couldn't help but think of what the old man Fan Yang said in Shidong Mountain, and he couldn't help but be shocked secretly. The human race's relic in Ten Thousand Monsters City turned out to be this wooden tripod. Although the properties of the wooden tripod were completely different from the ancient tripod he owned, his intuition told him that the wooden tripod in the sky was definitely one of the nine lost tripods from the era of the Human Emperor.
